attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Idaho military retirement exemption (2025). Conditional full exemption: fully exempt if disabled veteran OR age 62+, otherwise fully taxable. Honors MSRRA and SCRA. Source: MOAA State Report Card, ID State Tax Commission.

initial_action.action_postfix: "ID Military Retirement Exemption Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.id_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.id_military_retirement_taxable xdef

action_details.action_comment: Apply ID FULL military retirement exemption (disabled OR age 62+)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay /result.id_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.id_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"ID military retirement: FULL EXEMPTION (disabled OR age 62+). Disabled: " result.is_disabled cvs strconcat ", Age: " strconcat result.age cvs strconcat ", Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", Fully exempt" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No ID military retirement exemption (not disabled, age < 62)
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /result.id_military_retirement_exemption xdef result.military_retirement_pay /result.id_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"ID military retirement: NO EXEMPTION (not disabled, age < 62). Age: " result.age cvs strconcat ", Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", Fully taxable" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.id_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.id_military_retirement_taxable xdef "No ID military retirement pay - exemption not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto
